searchLog: Read profile.md, target-companies.json, sent-log.json (last ~40 'opportunities' entries), data/applications.json (empty tracker), and life/PIPELINE.md for exclusions -- Notion BDR, Stripe New Grad PM Accelerator, Disney APM, Tuck Business Bridge, IBM x6, Claude Corps (recruiter screen scheduled), Ford FCG, Red Ventures APM, TikTok APM, Goldman Sachs, CIL, MIT Future Fest, MLH, Horizon, Adobe x3, Micron, Kalshi, MATS, Anthropic Fellows July cohort, Northslope, Last Mile, Yale SOM -- all already applied to or closed, excluded regardless of egress state. Checked the graduation-date conflict this run's instructions flagged: life/PROFILE.md in fact reads 'Graduation: December 2026 -- SETTLED by Dom 2026-08-04,' matching morning-briefing/profile.md's December 2026. There is no live conflict -- the scheduler's 'Aug-Dec 2026 unsettled' framing is stale, as the prior two runs also found; it should be corrected at the source rather than re-flagged each day. Before spending search/fetch budget, re-verified WebFetch/egress directly: tested www.anthropic.com, job-boards.greenhouse.io, boards.greenhouse.io, and en.wikipedia.org (a non-careers control with no reason to be policy-blocked) -- all four returned EGRESS_BLOCKED from the proxy. The Wikipedia control is new this run and shows the block is a blanket WebFetch egress failure, not a job-board-specific policy. WebSearch still works and surfaced plausible listings (e.g. an Anthropic Applied AI Architect req on Greenhouse), but hunt.md's honesty rules forbid including anything not confirmed by fetching the live page, which remains impossible. No candidate could be verified, so none is included. Zero verified opportunities is the correct, honest output for an eighth straight week -- this is an unresolved environment-level network-egress gap, not a shortage of findable roles, and needs a human to fix the WebFetch proxy allowlist; no amount of additional search or retry budget changes this outcome.
